description: We are a team of passionate innovators interested in combining AI, software engineering, and space exploration to solve real-world challenges. With experience in computer science, machine learning, and data analysis, we aim to build an ambitious, impactful NASA Space Apps project. We welcome creative problem-solvers with skills in coding, AI/ML, data visualization, astronomy, UI/UX, and research. Whether you're experienced or eager to learn, we'd love to collaborate!
